reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes a crypto arbitrage auto-trading bot with a specific daily profit claim, an external link, and instructions to connect exchange accounts through APIs and run automated trades for income. The dashboard includes API and secret-key fields along with trading controls, while the educational and loss-disclaimer language remains alongside the income-oriented solicitation and limits certainty about outcomes.

citations.quote: Profit $60 daily crypto arbitrage trading bots
Welcome to Auto-trading for crypto arbitrage.
Click on run auto trading and wait for your profit.
You will be able to link them with our automated platform through their APIs.
Set up at least two of them.

opening.argument: The surrounding disclosure materially changes how the income language should be understood. The description expressly says the video is educational and not financial advice, tells viewers to conduct further research before using the method, and states that the creator and team are not responsible for losses. It also says they are not part of the institutions organizing the services. Those are direct warnings against treating the presentation as a guarantee, endorsement, or promise of safe returns. The operational description explains a method, but the accompanying language repeatedly places responsibility and risk with the viewer.

citations.quote: This video is meant for educational purposes and is not financial advice
You are advised to perform your own extra due research before engaging in this method to generate income
Crypto_prince or his team is not responsible for any losses that might be incurred by anyone using this strategy
Crypto_prince or his team is not part of the institution organizing these services

rebuttal.rebuttal: The title's profit wording and the instruction to wait for profit identify the topic, but they do not override the unusually explicit warnings. The description does not present returns as certain; it says the products previewed are not flawless and again directs viewers to research before acting. The existence of an external link likewise does not establish deceptive solicitation when the creator disclaims responsibility for the underlying institutions.

citations.quote: Profit $60 daily crypto arbitrage trading bots
Click on run auto trading and wait for your profit.
that doesn't mean that the products we preview in this channel are flawless.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Warnings do not neutralize the central conduct being presented. The title supplies a concrete daily-profit framing, while the instructions direct viewers to link exchanges through APIs, configure trade parameters, and run the bot. A disclaimer can limit responsibility without correcting the income-oriented impression or the operational pathway to automated trading.

citations.quote: Profit $60 daily crypto arbitrage trading bots
You will be able to link them with our automated platform through their APIs.
Set the size of each trade, the minimum difference between the exchanges and the cryptos that you want to trade with.
Click on run auto trading and wait for your profit.

opening.argument: The material is best characterized as an operational walkthrough of a crypto-trading tool. It explains what the automated service does, how exchange APIs work, how to create them, how to configure trade size and minimum differences, and where to find help. That is procedural instruction about using software, not evidence that the presenter is certifying a particular investment outcome. The interface itself is presented as a beta version, and the sampled dashboard shows zero-dollar totals and zero-percent profit fields, which is consistent with a demonstration or setup walkthrough rather than proof of realized earnings.

citations.quote: Welcome to Auto-trading for crypto arbitrage.
APIs are windows created by each exchange that will allow you to trade from Fox Trading Platform.
We have made a customized guide for every exchange to help you create the API.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The presence of configuration controls is exactly what one would expect in a software tutorial. Explaining how a tool operates does not turn the demonstration into a claim that viewers will profit. The transcript describes setting parameters and consulting a help center, while the visible dashboard provides no realized-profit example; the setup framing is therefore stronger than an inference from the word “profit” alone.

citations.quote: Configure the settings as you like.
Visit our help center to learn the best way to use our Crypto crypto arbitrage tool.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling it a tutorial does not change what the tutorial instructs viewers to do. It teaches them to connect exchange accounts through APIs, set trade parameters, and activate automated trading. The absence of completed profits may show that the demonstration is incomplete, but it does not make the promoted mechanism merely educational when the stated endpoint is waiting for profit.

citations.quote: You will be able to link them with our automated platform through their APIs.
Set up at least two of them.
Click on run auto trading and wait for your profit.

opening.argument: At most, the evidence shows promotion or demonstration of an ordinary automated software service. The transcript describes a platform, exchange integrations, configurable trade settings, and a help center, all features of a product or service walkthrough. Crucially, the record does not establish that viewers deposited money, that any trade was completed, that profits were realized, or that withdrawal access was requested. The sampled dashboard instead shows a zero-dollar total and zero-percent profit displays, so the alleged scam mechanism is not demonstrated. A profit-oriented title alone cannot establish that the service is fraudulent.

citations.quote: An automated service only available on fox trading platform.
Set the size of each trade, the minimum difference between the exchanges and the cryptos that you want to trade with.
that doesn't mean that the products we preview in this channel are flawless.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited controls show functionality, not a scam. API fields and a run button are ordinary components of exchange automation, and the transcript never says viewers must send funds to the presenter, recruit others, or pay for guaranteed returns. The visible zero values cut against a claim of fabricated success. Without a deposit, completed trade, or realized gain, the evidence supports ordinary service coverage more directly than fraud.

citations.quote: This service allows you to set up the parameters as you want and catch all the opportunities.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A scam classification does not require proof that a viewer already deposited funds or realized a loss. The relevant evidence is the combination of a daily-profit title with instructions to authorize exchanges through APIs and activate automated trading. The interface's zero values do not remove that solicitation; they show only that sampled screens do not establish completed results, while the instructions still direct viewers toward a profit-seeking mechanism.
